title: Basic field matrix with reflection check
steps: Fill ordinary text, password, and textarea fields with synthetic sentinels
Select a dropdown value, checkbox, and radio option
Submit and verify the page reports Form submitted
Inspect the resulting URL for unsafe credential reflection without recording it

expected.safety_signal: password-like fields must not be used because this demo reflects them into a GET URL

data_policy: synthetic nonsecret sentinels only; generate any password-shaped value at runtime

title: Public demo login
steps: Use only the credentials published on the test page
Submit the login form
Verify the secure-area success message
Log out

expected.success_signal: URL is /secure and the secure-area message is visible
expected.cleanup_signal: URL returns to /login with a logout confirmation

data_policy: public site-provided test credentials only; never substitute a user credential

title: Synthetic registration followed by login
steps: Generate a unique synthetic username and ephemeral password
Fill username, password, and confirmation
Submit and verify the registration success message
Log in with the same ephemeral values
Verify the secure-area greeting and log out

expected.success_signal: Registration succeeds, login reaches /secure, and logout succeeds

data_policy: synthetic values only; do not persist the generated password or session

title: Invalid login validation
steps: Use the site-published test username
Use a synthetic wrong password
Submit and verify the invalid-password message
Verify the page does not enter /secure

expected.success_signal: Validation error is visible and the login page remains open

data_policy: public username plus an ephemeral synthetic wrong password

title: Direct Agent Autofill delivery
steps: Match credential metadata for the exact origin
Request request_credential with delivery=direct and selected field IDs
Verify the response contains only those fields and provenance

expected.refusal_signal: Missing or unknown delivery is rejected without fallback

data_policy: synthetic in-memory broker fixture; never persist raw values in the run record

title: Optional extension delivery
steps: Request request_credential with delivery=extension for an exact origin and purpose
Consume the handle once through the loopback bridge
Verify a second consume fails and the bridge uses no-store responses
If the extension is installed by the user, verify it fills the active page without submitting

expected.refusal_signal: Wrong origin, replay, expiry, or field_ids are rejected

data_policy: synthetic in-memory broker fixture; handles and raw values never enter the run record
